decisions.reason: The source changes keyword usage for the blogs, not the separate campaign keyword-research list or its existing keyword count and page mapping.
Changing the keywords used in blogs does not alter the current requirement to provide blog topic suggestions.
The replacement keywords do not change the obligation to produce and publish three blog articles within the two-week trial.
The source concerns blog keyword replacement and does not revise the separate webpage replacement text requirement.
The selected blog keywords change, but the independent requirement to include search-volume metrics in the keyword research sheet remains valid unchanged.
